claim: Netflix set a record with $12.1B in revenue during the fiscal first quarter of 2026.
summary: As of knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04, fiscal Q1 2026 had not yet occurred/reported. The $12.1B figure and its record status cannot be established from prior knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Netflix's revenue in fiscal Q1 2026 was $12.1B
sub_claims.stated_text: $12.1B in revenue during the fiscal first quarter of 2026
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before the end of fiscal Q1 2026 (Jan-Mar 2026). Prior knowledge cannot establish this future quarter's revenue.

sub_claims.text: That Q1 2026 revenue was a record high for Netflix
sub_claims.note: Record-high status depends on unverified Q1 2026 figure and comparison to all prior quarters, which cannot be established from knowledge available at cutoff.
